_comment: Save as .vscode/mcp.json in your project (or add via 'MCP: Add Server'). No clone and no absolute paths — npx fetches the published package, and Node >= 20.11 is the only prerequisite. REVIEW_BUDDY_CWD uses the ${workspaceFolder} variable so the server knows the repo even if the agent forgets to pass cwd. --standalone = detached: submit_review returns the URL immediately (Copilot's MCP tool timeout is not configurable). Swap @latest for a pinned version (e.g. review-buddy@0.4.0) if you want reproducible startups.
